firstMessage.content:
Hi everyone, I’m Hengji (bosprimigenious), currently competing solo and looking for two complementary teammates for a three-person Name That LLM team.

My best public score is 0.473 from a CPU text/style and public-pool baseline. I can contribute reproducible baseline experiments, prompt-grouped validation and integration work, using my RTX 4060 and free Kaggle compute. My experiments are AI-assisted.

I’m looking for complementary experience in:

  • NLP classifiers, efficient fine-tuning or LoRA;
  • data provenance, prompt-overlap checks, grouped validation or ensemble analysis.

The collaboration would use free compute and hardware we already own. If interested, please reply with your Kaggle handle, current team size, a relevant public experiment or past competition, roughly how much time you could contribute, and whether the compute constraint works for you.

We would confirm fit, membership and competition limits before any formal invitation or merger. Code and artifacts would be shared within an officially formed team under the competition rules.

Thanks for considering it!
